issue: Feishu backend authorization succeeded, but EcoreX channel stayed not_configured because app credentials were not persisted.

rootCauses.summary: Register flow now accepts client_id/client_secret, app_id/app_secret, camelCase variants, and common nested result containers.
Bundled local runtime now has lark-oapi installed, and future Windows installers self-heal the dependency before service startup.
The previous Feishu app secret was never written to config.json, so the current runtime remains missing credentials until the operator scans again or manually enters App ID/App Secret.

verification.command: python -m py_compile common/feishu_register_credentials.py channel/web/web_channel.py channel/feishu/feishu_channel.py tests/test_ecorex_web_parallel_backend.py scripts/smoke-web-hotfix-contracts.py
